tenantId: The tenant (organization or project) the record belongs to, or the call acts in.
identityId: The id of the person or service account.
packageId: The id of the access package.
bindingId: The id of the role binding.
policyId: The id of the stored policy.
webhookId: The id of the webhook subscription.
campaignId: The id of the certification campaign.
agreementId: The id of the terms-of-use agreement.
trustId: The id of the trust that permits the role assumption.
credentialId: The id of the API key.
accessRequestId: The id of the access request.
assignmentId: The id of the package assignment.
activationId: The id of the just-in-time activation.
itemId: The id of the review item.
uniqueKey: A natural key the database keeps unique within the tenant and collection.
createdAt: When it was created, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
updatedAt: When it last changed, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
expiresAt: When it ends, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Absent means it does not expire.
startsAt: When it starts applying, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
deletedAt: When it was deleted, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
decidedAt: When the decision was made, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
requestedAt: When the request was made, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
reviewedAt: When it was reviewed, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
activatedAt: When the activation started, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
acceptedAt: When it was accepted, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
assignedAt: When it was assigned, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
closedAt: When it was closed, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
verifiedAt: When it was verified, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
lastCheckedAt: When it was last checked, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
lastSeenAt: When it was last used, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
lastUsedAt: When it was last used, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
authenticatedAt: When the person last authenticated in this session, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
lastFailedAt: When the last failed attempt happened, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
dueAt: When it is due, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
generatedAt: When the result was computed, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
timestamp: When it happened, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
durationMs: A length of time in milliseconds.
requestedDurationMs: How long the requester asked for, in milliseconds.
unusedForMs: Only include items not used for at least this many milliseconds.
createdBy: The id of the identity that created it.
decidedBy: The id of the identity that made the decision.
assignedBy: The id of the identity that assigned it.
requesterId: The id of the identity that asked for it.
actorId: The id of the identity that performed the action.
name: A human-readable name.
phone: A phone number in international format.
emailVerified: Whether the email address has been verified.
phoneVerified: Whether the phone number has been verified.
rootAdmin: Whether the identity holds platform root authority.
owner: Whether the identity is an owner of its tenant.
deletedEmail: The email address a deleted identity had, kept for audit after the address was released.
revoked: Whether it has been revoked. Revoked records no longer grant anything.
active: Whether it is currently in effect.
deleted: True when the record was deleted.
suppressed: Whether the finding has been suppressed.
protected: Whether it is protected from being changed or deleted.
managed: Whether IAM manages it (as opposed to your application).
mfa: Whether the session completed multi-factor authentication.
mfaRequired: True when a second factor is still needed before a session is issued.
statements: The policy's statements. Each allows or denies actions on resource patterns, optionally under conditions.
boundary: A policy document that limits the maximum access without granting any.
ceiling: A policy document that caps what access through this path can do.
sourcePolicy: A policy document that further limits a temporary session.
accessPolicy: The tenant's rules for just-in-time elevation (see TenantAccessPolicy).
limits: The tenant's plan limits: maximum numbers of identities, groups, roles, and other records.
actions: Action names or patterns, such as `documents:*`.
resources: Resource patterns such as `document/*`, where `*` matches any run of characters.
resource: The resource the request is about: its `type` and `id`.
subjectType: Whether the subject is an `identity` or a `group`.
subjectId: The id of the identity or group it applies to.
parentId: The id of the parent: the parent tenant, or the parent resource.
parentType: The resource type of the parent resource.
relation: A relation name, such as `viewer` or `editor`.
window: An access window: the days and hours during which the binding applies.
timeZone: An IANA time zone, such as `Europe/Berlin`.
justification: Why the access is needed. Stored with the request or activation and recorded in the audit log.
note: A free-text note recorded with the decision.
password: The password. Sent only over HTTPS and stored only as a hash.
token: A one-time token from a delivered link, or a bearer token, depending on the call.
challenge: The id of a pending multi-factor challenge, passed back to the call that completes it.
challengeId: The id of a pending challenge.
deviceToken: The token of a remembered device, so a later sign-in on that device can skip the second factor.
rememberDevice: Remember this device after a successful second factor.
deviceExpiresAt: When the remembered device stops being trusted, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
client: The client that made the request: its IP address and user agent, when known.
lastClient: The client of the most recent use: IP address and user agent, when known.
lastFailedClient: The client of the most recent failed attempt: IP address and user agent, when known.
userAgent: The browser or client's user agent string.
limit: The maximum number of items to return.
offset: How many items to skip, for paging.
total: The total number of matching items, before paging.
items: The items of this page or batch.
includeExpired: Also include records that have lapsed.
secret: A secret value, returned only once. Store it immediately.
metadata: Extra structured details about the event.
headers: HTTP request headers carrying the caller's session cookie or `Authorization: Bearer` token.
outcomes: Which outcomes to include: `allow`, `deny`, or both.
issuer: The issuer: the identity provider or authority that vouched for it.
domain: A DNS domain name, such as `acme.com`.
dnsRecord: The DNS TXT record to publish to prove control of the domain.
threshold: The value at which it triggers.
unusedDays: Report items unused for at least this many days.
suspendedDetail: Details about why it was suspended.
progress: How many items are decided and how many remain.
undecided: How many items have no decision yet.
decided: How many items have a decision.
violations: Who breaks the rule, with the decision that shows it.
changes: The changes that were made or would be made.
dryRun: Compute the result without changing anything.
